system.description:
Attuning your senses to the babble of the restless dead, you open both eyes and ears to the Underworld and comprehend the speech of wraiths.

Expend a Willpower Trait to attune yourself for a scene or an hour, whichever ends first. During this time you can both see and hear all that transpires in the Underworld around you, and you understand the language of the dead; unless a wraith deliberately uses a tongue you do not know, you comprehend its words.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
